question: Can the leading exterior potential-flow added-mass eigenspace predict the acute inclinations of a freely falling TRAIL3 irregular aggregate more accurately than the largest solid moment, maximum projected union area and a morphology-trained empirical control?
input: All20 named STLs only. No fall Re, X, inclination, trajectory, aggregate table statistics or same-shape labels for primary forecasts. Finite-Re effective geometry comparator. 128 same-source rows, 5.129<=observed Re<=1927.996, are held for receiving.
mechanics: Prescribed uniform relative translation along lab vertical; Tfluid=rho U^2 n^T M n/2. With infinitesimal body rotation dtheta, dn=n cross dtheta; tau=(M n) cross n times rho U^2. A positive angular-damping closure promotes a local maximum of T for an otherwise unconstrained axis. Free translation, wake lift and steady resistance excluded. Inviscid equation supplies no terminal speed.
cases: Report all128 complete observed rows grouped all20 exact workbook merged name IDs. Immutable primary predictions against every run; equal-shaped mean absolute error in degrees, worst complete shape, and 3-axis raw tail. No drop for regime or numerical performance. Metadata-only published aggregates and apparatus statements retained.
axes: Full primary compare archived reported mean gravity-to-principal-line inclinations, G/H/I are min/mean/max, ensure all min/mean/max between0..90 (plus rounding 1e-8) and ordered. For a solid I gap <.02 Imax, use sole isolated axis angle for resolved primary; both clustered and all raw axes compulsory secondary. All shapes have an isolated axis. Compare equal shape average first, then maximum shape loss. Retain exact all-axis reports. Min/max are observed per-run ranges only, never a signed tilt trajectory.
predictors: Munk leading eigenpair of discrete fluid tensor from prescribed unit translations on grid24 and40, outer radius3.5L; fine40 primary, coarse24 diagnostic; within1.5% of leading eigenvalue average unsigned angles in the corresponding eigenspace. Maximum projected triangle union across96 fixed antipodal directions+3 inertia axes, 4 multistart refinements 9,4,1.5,.5deg/6 spokes; average separated near-tied maxima .05%. Other baselines Imax vertical, isotropic mean. Training-only geometry predictors fixed before any angles: leave one literal broad source-name prefix C/Cr/P/Sq/St group out simultaneously including all scales/rows, predict per-geometry mean of run means via 1) fit-only constant 2) Gaussian kernel ridge on standardized [Imin/Imax,Imid/Imax,log surface area of unit-volume body, log true max/min extent aspect, plus exact union area at best searched direction], median pairwise train distance, lambda=.1 diagonal, train-only intercept. Clip results to0..90. All20 forecasts of source-only arms lock before targets. (No full parent generator provenance beyond observed design grouping; no independent-lab claim.)
gates: Candidate must strictly beat Imax, union-max and both empirical controls on BOTH mean and worst covered shape; all8 contrasts compulsory. Relative grid convergence and sensitive nearly tied outputs reported, no refinement chosen from outcomes. Whole held study unscored on unresolvable geometry, nonpositive tensor, incompatible target angular contract, or unresolved missing original. Source qualification requires every mesh reproducible after exact zero-area facet removal, source ratio reproduction <=.002 absolute, duplicate parent groups grouped if authenticated. Numerical admission before decoding angles requires every finite grid volume on fine40 in [.85,1.15], every coarse24 to fine40 resolved-angle mean difference <=10deg, and authentic synthetic sphere/ellipsoid <10% relative tensor error at28. Geometry outputs stay locked; any failures reported before further change. Independent recount compulsory.
